method: python3 osspr-intake/harness/bench.py <target> times that function only, after building inputs. baseline_median_ms is the median of 11 samples following 3 warmups. baseline_noise_pct is pstdev/median*100. The cyclic GC is collected between samples and disabled during each sample. Measured on upstream main e4e41c33c7a31c6f02aa38db643ec31cc338208a. semantic.normalize is excluded (merged in chenxiachan/textfold#118). No open upstream performance PR covers these functions.

targets.workload: 400 English paragraphs, one _cjk_share call each, matching ladder.budgets_of on a 400-unit import. Each character calls tokens.is_cjk, which recompiles a regex.
One tokenize_text call on the same 400 paragraphs joined. The WORD regex carries every combining-mark range from tokens._marks.

Four unsplit CJK paragraphs of 2500 characters. Each call is lcs_pairs of the first 60 normalised tokens against the whole paragraph, the shape of ladder.align. CJK units are not cut by sentence count.
tokens.norm on every token of the 400-paragraph book. align calls norm on the brief and on the evidence tokens before lcs_pairs. Each call runs re.sub with the combining-mark class.
160 distinct display formulas. tex_math is separate from normalize (pull 118 changed tree walks in normalize, not this converter). Each call parses LaTeX and builds a BeautifulSoup math element.

24 texts already sliced to detect's 40_000-character cap (English, Chinese, German, French, repeated). detect scans the text once per script regex and, for Latin, scores every word against each language's small-word list.
